why: Chris, 1 October 2026: "all level names change per course ... each courses level icons need to be generated independently". Nine levels per family (lib/practice.php PracticeRanks(): programming for Pascal and Java, SQL, theory, AI); the frame grows bronze to silver to gold to a jewelled starburst. PracticeRankEmblem() uses public/assets/rank-art/<family>/<index>.png once it exists and draws the old emblem until then.
style: A glossy 3D game rank emblem, smooth shiny enamel and metal, soft studio light, like a reward in a mobile game. The whole emblem centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
